I built the part and exported it to `submission.step`. It is one valid solid, and the STEP file read back with the same volume and bounding box as the model.

**What the part is:** a locator block 100 (X) × 41 (Y) × 63 (Z). A rectangular notch, 44 wide and 17 deep, runs the full height through the middle of the +Y face (x = 28 to 72). Four Ø4 holes go through the block in Y, at x = 14 and 86 and z = 8 and 55. They come out on the −Y face and on the two +Y faces either side of the notch, which matches the holes visible in the reference.

**How close it is:** I rendered the four camera views and compared them with `composite.png`. The outline, the position of the notch and the hole layout all matched. I then spread the holes further apart vertically to match the reference more closely. I didn't render a new preview after that last change, and the STEP file includes it.

All dimensions are estimated from the images, so expect small errors in proportions. The likeliest are the notch depth and the overall height: two of the views gave slightly different readings for the height.
